2014_spells.airy-name.fullDescription: Using 1 minute, you reach into the plane of air and use it to hide a creature from detection. You reach into the plane of air and use it to hide a creature from detection. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 hour; you can cast it as a ritual.
